text:
support_jess: FYI customer 'Acme Health' (acct ACME-HLTH-004) says procurement will not accept any invoice unless a PO is on file. They paused payments. Can billing hold issuing final invoice until we have PO?

billing_amy: Do we have a PO number yet or a signed document? We need either PO# or vendor onboarding completed (W-9/VAT) to create an invoice. If nothing, we can create a DRAFT and tag it, but collections will be paused.

sales_miguel: I spoke with their procurement lead (Lena M.) — they've asked for our vendor setup and a matching PO referencing the subscription/SOW. I already sent the vendor form link and asked them to expedite. Procurement said "no invoice without PO" explicitly.

finance_rob: For clarity: we can issue a pro forma/draft invoice with status="pending_po" in our system, but external billing (sending a payable invoice) is blocked until PO# is provided. If sales expects an exception, legal/finance need written confirmation from their procurement.

legal_sophie: If they require the PO on their side before invoice acceptance that's normal. We should not create a legal obligation tied to a placeholder PO. If sales wants us to reserve capacity or lock pricing, get an email from their procurement confirming the PO will follow by X date.

support_jess: Procurement contact: lena.m@acme-health.com, phone +1-617-555-0193. They said "PO will be raised by next Tue EOD" but will only after vendor registration form is complete.

billing_amy: Ok — action items for us: 1) Sales to confirm expected PO date in thread/email, 2) Customer to send PO# or signed PO doc to billing@redwood.com, 3) If VAT/exemption applies, send VAT reg number or W-9. I'll create draft invoice and mark it PENDING_PO to avoid automated reminders.

sales_miguel: Confirmed — I'll ask Lena to cc procurement + procurement@acme-health.com on the PO email and include the SOW reference (SOW-ACME-2026-01) and subscription id sub_8934.

sales_ops_bot: AUTO: Created ticket BILL-7621, queue=billing, priority=high, owner=billing_amy.

finance_rob: Sample draft invoice note I'll use (please review):
```
invoice_id: INV-2026-0893-draft
account: ACME-HLTH-004
amount_due: $18,400.00
currency: USD
status: DRAFT (pending PO#)
note: "Do not send to collections. Final invoice will be issued upon receipt of customer PO referencing SOW-ACME-2026-01 or subscription sub_8934."
```

billing_amy: That wording works. I'll add internal tag `pending_po` and disable automated dunning for this invoice. Also creating a vendor onboarding checklist item for legal tax docs.

support_jess: Please ping me when draft is created so I can tell the customer it's in progress. Lena asked for an "official reference" they can attach to the PO — maybe the draft invoice id is enough.

billing_amy: Draft created INV-2026-0893-draft and saved to BILL-7621. I've emailed standard vendor form link: https://billing.redwood.com/vendor-form and requested W-9/VAT doc.

sales_miguel: I'll follow up with procurement and ask for PO to be sent directly to billing@redwood.com and cc me. ETA asked: Tue EOD.

finance_rob: I'll log an exception to prevent auto-finalization of the draft for 14 days; if PO not received, we'll trigger follow-up workflow.

support_jess: Thanks team — will update the customer thread. If procurement pushes the timeline, we'll escalate to account exec.

billing_amy: noted. closing loop here once PO received. :thumbsup:
